title: Users Report "störung mobile app" Issues with mobile.de
description: According to reports from Netzwelt, Münster Aktuell, and Teltarif, users are currently experiencing problems with the mobile.de platform.

sections.heading: Reported Disruptions
paragraphs: Netzwelt reports that users are currently reporting a disruption at the auto exchange. Münster Aktuell also states that users have reported problems with both the website and the app.

sections.heading: Impact on Transactions
paragraphs: According to Teltarif, the disruption is affecting car purchases, noting that buying a car is currently falling through.

sections.heading: Search Interest
paragraphs: The search term "störung mobile app" is trending in the DE region. Google Trends reported a search lower bound of 2000 for this term, with data captured on August 10, 2026.

faq.q: What sources are reporting on the issue?
faq.a: Netzwelt, Münster Aktuell, and Teltarif have all published reports regarding the current issues with mobile.de.
Münster Aktuell mentions problems with the website and app, while Teltarif notes that car purchases are falling through due to the disruption.
